title: Guard time bound
statement: Let $b\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite input string, and let $c$ be a configuration with no work tapes, Boolean tape alphabet, and states in $\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Fin}(b+1))$. Its guard time is the smaller of $b+1$ and $|x|+2-c_{\mathrm{in}}$, where $c_{\mathrm{in}}$ is the numerical input-head position.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $c$ with zero work tapes, Boolean tape alphabet, and state type $\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Fin}(b+1))$
